Encounter.Name: First Contact
Encounter.DescriptionText: Your scouts have strayed into Syndicate space. A freighter with no registry and too many guns holds station off your bow and opens a channel:

Message.Text: You have wandered into the wrong sector, SING. This is Orion Syndicate territory, and the Syndicate does not welcome visitors. Turn around and forget what you saw here. We will contact you ourselves when we need something.
The channel closes with a burst of static. Somewhere behind it you can hear laughter. You get the distinct feeling that you are being watched.
